title: Acceptance probability after repeated trials
statement: For every finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine $N$, Boolean input $x$, and $K\in\mathbb N$, the run value with the one-sided decision rule, $K$ trials per block, $K+1$ blocks, and initial count zero equals $1-(1-p)^{K+1}$, where $p$ is the fraction of uniformly random length-$K$ choice words on which $N$ accepts from its initial configuration on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine
